then.description: Your Protection oath's benefits also stop foes from **piercing** your armor.

else.description:
Gain the **Oaths of Conviction - Liege** Paladin Starting Move: you have sworn a righteous oath and service to a liege; name them now: ___par1pln:leader/institution/organization__.

You start with the oath below marked. As long as you uphold it, you can use its benefit:
pick: Protection (Never let an innocent die in your presence). Your weapon deals **holy** DMG, add +1 to your armor, and its benefits also stop foes from **piercing** your armor

submoves.title: Broken Oaths
submoves.description: When you **break an oath** (your call), clear that oath and lock a Condition. When you **find a way to atone** (also your call), clear a Condition and mark a cleared oath.

submoves.title: Hold the Line
submoves.description: When a **near** NPC attempts to harm or move towards an ally, you may interpose and roll+CHA.

outcomes.text: They get past you, but their next dmg dealt is halved (rounded down).
They find an opening against you and your ally; mark 1 XP and the GM makes a Move.

title: A Shot at Redemption
description: When you **offer a defeated foe an opportunity to change their ways**, offer them proof of your sincerity and roll+CHA.

outcomes.text: They'll make their best attempt at it.
They're interested but will need constant monitoring and guidance.
They aren't ready; mark 1 XP and the GM makes a Move.

title: "For the Honor of…"
description: Once per session, when you **assume a heroic form related to your Origins**, choose one benefit below up to your CHA, which lasts until you **Face Death**, **Reach Your Limit**, or the scene ends, whichever happens first.
pick: All allies who witness it clear a Condition
All foes who witness it ignore your allies for now and treat you as the biggest threat
Reduce dmg taken by half (rounded down) from NPCs with evil intent

title: Inspiring Presence
description: When you **rally your allies with a show of commitment**, roll+CHA.

outcomes.text: You can mark a Condition so up to your CHA of them clear a Condition.
Your action is ignored; mark 1 XP and the GM makes a Move.

title: You Will Not Break Me
description: When you **Reach Your Limit**, you may also choose from the options below. If you do, you only clear up to CHA Conditions, but may mark 1 Depth with a PC who helped you:

outcomes.text: Make a show of force or lash out at your foes
Sound the retreat or make a personal sacrifice
Confront your fears or confide in another
Seek guidance or submit to authority
